name: Gossip Menu Option
description: Clickable options of gossip menus. Defines the icon, text and required npc flags of each option, and the action performed when a player selects it: open a submenu, open the vendor/trainer/taxi/bank window, show a point of interest on the map or run a dbscripts_on_gossip script.

fields.name: Npc Flag
fields.help: Npc flags the creature must have for this option to be shown. Note: CMaNGOS Classic uses the vanilla flag layout (0x4 vendor, 0x8 flightmaster, 0x2000 stablemaster, ...) which differs from the TBC+ values listed here.

fields.name: Submenu Id
fields.help: Gossip menu opened when this option is selected. 0 = none.

fields.name: Submenu
fields.help: Open the submenu this option leads to.

fields.name: Action Poi Id
fields.help: Point of interest highlighted on the player's map when this option is selected. 0 = none.

fields.name: POI
fields.help: Open the point of interest shown by this option.

fields.name: Action Script Id
fields.help: Id of a dbscripts_on_gossip script executed when this option is selected. 0 = none.

fields.name: Box Coded
fields.help: If 1, selecting the option opens a text box asking the player to enter a code.

fields.name: Box Money
fields.help: Money (in copper) required in the confirmation box before the option is executed.

fields.name: Box Text
fields.help: Text shown in the confirmation box popped up by this option.

fields.name: Condition Id
fields.help: Entry in the `conditions` table that must be satisfied for this option to be shown. 0 = always.

fields.name: Condition
fields.help: Edit the condition tree controlling whether this option is shown.
fields.meta: mangos_conditions:condition_id;source=the NPC / GO the menu belongs to;target=Player
